event: Solenne steps through the door onto a vast black-stone floor dotted with pillars.
The System announces the Floor 10 Major Boss: Ironjaw Sentinel, Lv25, three phases.
Nadia says, "Well. It's here," and for once gives the thing no name.
Solenne calls Tomás, who runs Terrain Read for twenty seconds.
Tomás reports thirty-four geometric pillars and the Sentinel waiting at the far end.
The pillar map appears in everyone's Status Window via the Harmony Conductor.
Solenne senses the Sentinel's armor and mana through Arcane Analysis.
Dayo's bracer shows four tally marks; she has not added a fifth.
Solenne gives positions and roles in thirty seconds; the party listens.
Dayo walks across the thirty-meter aggro line.
The forty-meter Ironjaw Sentinel strides forward from the far wall.
Dayo plants in Iron Stance, buckler up, drawing its threat.
Arcane Analysis shows 35% physical, 40% magic reduction and three weak points.
Dayo takes the first jaw strike on her buckler; the Gambit reflects damage.
A second low strike lands on her gauntlet; secondary hits drop Dayo to 397 HP.
Tomás puts arrows into the left then right shoulder joints from forty-five meters.
Miriam's Nature's Veil and Mending Touch keep Dayo regenerating.
Solenne calls Stumble; Nadia staggers the Sentinel's right ankle.
Dayo Shield Rushes the staggered leg, breaking its footing for two seconds.
Solenne calls the window and Nadia throws the last Null Compound at its chest.
The Sentinel's magic armor collapses for eight seconds.
Solenne channels Ley Conduit, doubling her INT to 56 through the enhanced staff.
Solenne fires three full-power Arcane Bolts into the exposed chest.
About three thousand HP go in eight seconds; Solenne's hands shake after.
Four minutes in, Phase 1 settles into a working rhythm; the boss is near 70% HP.
In the rhythm Solenne decides the party deserve the truth now, not after Floor 10.
Solenne reaches beneath the Conductor's tactical feed for its connection.
Solenne sends six words to all: the Tower was designed for us.
The channel goes quiet for half a second.
Dayo says, "Yeah," and catches the next jaw strike.
Miriam, mid-cast, answers with a fractionally warmer Mending Touch on Dayo.
Party Record logs Harmonize's first communication use, no precedent.
Solenne lets the note sit; the boss is at 68% and Phase 2 is coming.
Tomás glances over from his pillar with visible relief.
Solenne turns back to the Sentinel and fires.
At 60% HP the Sentinel freezes mid-attack and studies them all.
The Sentinel charges a pillar and pivots off it, reversing direction in a second.
Unable to plant against shifting angles, Dayo drops Iron Stance.
Dayo runs to cut off its approach at the second pillar, reading it like a pitch.
Solenne calls Sleep; Nadia's Chaos Grenade puts the Sentinel to sleep mid-charge.
The sleeping Sentinel slides into a pillar base and lies still.
Nadia readies a second grenade.
Solenne tells Tomás to hold, but he takes a clean jaw-base shot.
The arrow breaks the Sleep four seconds early; the Sentinel rises, eyes on Dayo.
Nadia's second grenade lands Slow for eight seconds.
Dayo, unrooted, uses the pillars as geometry to deflect its charges.
Her lateral Shield Rush forces the Sentinel into a narrow pillar cluster.
The Sentinel crashes through a column and staggers.
Dayo punches its jaw joint; its charge goes wide.
Tomás puts two arrows into the right shoulder joint.
Solenne watches Dayo play the whole fight like a pitch through the Conductor.
Nadia runs flanking patterns, using Burst Speed after each Stumble.
Tomás repositions pillar to pillar; Miriam's heals keep Dayo's HP climbing.
Vesper watches the Gambit and Dayo's movement with brief satisfaction.
Slow ends; Dayo cuts the surge off at the fourth pillar and it stumbles.
Nadia says, "Okay good."
The Sentinel's HP crosses thirty percent.
Phase 3: the Sentinel locks still and weighs each of the six.
The System shows Phase 3: target acquired.
The target indicator appears over Miriam's head.
